summary: A medieval timber watchtower, about 16 m to the finial on a 5.1 m square footing (the motte-and-palisade type… joints door, shutter_0, shutter_1, shutter_2, shutter_3, shutter_4, …; sockets socket_door_outside, socket_lookout.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.watchtower_wood or place "prefab": "watchtower_wood" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
